Hello! I am an Ocean Resilience Program Manager for [The Bay Foundation](https://www.santamonicabay.org) and a current master's student in the [Claisse Lab](https://www.claisselab.com) at Cal Poly Pomona. My thesis project will document early stage kelp forest recovery following active restoration off the Palos Verdes Peninsula.

I am dedicated to the conservation of marine coastal ecosystems and have actively contributed to the restoration of kelp forests, eelgrass beds, and endangered white abalone in the Santa Monica Bay since 2022. As a Program Manager for TBF, I lead the Palos Verdes Kelp Forest Restoration Project, Malibu and Catalina Eelgrass Restoration Projects, Volunteer Diving Program, and Ocean Resilience Program Internships. I am an experienced American Academy of Underwater Sciences (AAUS) SCUBA diver with over 600 professional dives in the Southern California Bight.
